Samir: Heads-up  Lyonesse pilot post-mortem. Theyre open to a case study + translated social posts for EU and APAC. Need signed release + localization notes.

Bea: Great. They reported a ~5.1x inference throughput uplift on batch jobs and ~30% lower per-unit cost in our integration tests. We should confirm what wording theyre comfortable publishing.

Noelle (Lyonesse): Confirming the numbers. We can share the integration report under NDA. For localization: we prefer EU-FR and JP translations for social, and a short localized quote for the JP market.

Owen (Legal): Please paste proposed public quote here. We require a data-source sentence and the signed release (use the localization clause if translations will be published).

Samir: Draft hero quote: "Lyonesse saw a 5.1x throughput increase and roughly 30% lower per-unit inference cost in our integration tests."

Owen (Legal): 'Roughly 30%' ok if they attach the report. Add: "Benchmarking conducted on integration tests; data provided by Lyonesse under NDA." Also add a translation approval step in the release: customer must sign off on non-English copies.

Noelle (Lyonesse): We'll attach the report and we will review translations. Please include a 7-day embargo option before APAC push.

Ari (Partnerships): Also request the ability to run a co-branded webinar for APAC—would need a speaker slot and 2 weeks notice. Marketing needs final quote + release 72h before promotion.

marketing-bot: Release templates: https://drive.redwood/release-templates/customer-localization-release.pdf

Bea: Plan: 1) Send release + translation clause, 2) get signed release + report link, 3) produce EN blog + EU-FR + JP short posts, 4) if customer ok, schedule APAC webinar.

Noelle (Lyonesse): Signing release now and granting access to the report: https://share.lyonesse/pilots/redwood-integration-report.pdf (access granted).

Owen (Legal): Uploaded redline with translation approval language and embargo options: https://legal.redwood/redlines/3312109999. Please don't publish translations until customer approvess the non-EN copy.

Samir: Thanks. Bea will draft the EN copy tomorrow 9am PT; Ari will scope webinar dates; Owen will clear legal. Target publish (EN) next Tue if release and approvals are complete.

Bea: Draft incoming tomorrow 9am PT. Will include a short localization brief for EU and JP teams.

Noelle (Lyonesse): All set on our side. Looking forward to the localized assets. :sparkles:
